svg.text: 50° 47.0′ N · 000° 04.0′ E · heights in metres above Admiralty chart datum
on shaded days, summer time: add 1 hour
HEIGHTS IN METRES ABOVE ADMIRALTY CHART DATUM. Mean level at NEWHAVEN: 3.71 m. High waters in black, low waters in grey.
TIMES IN UTC, standard (winter) time, in four figures. On shaded days, summer time: add 1 hour. The clocks change on 31 March and 27 October, in red.
coef: the FRENCH tidal coefficient, not a number of this port: one for each high water at Brest, with its time under it in this page's time, and it holds for the whole Channel.
It is here because you enter the Shom tidal stream atlas with it: take the one whose Brest time is nearest yours. Moon: ● new · ◐ first quarter · ○ full · ◑ last quarter.
Harmonic constants analysed from Copernicus Marine In Situ TAC observations; National Oceanography Centre stations. Not for navigation.
